## Overview

**Greeting Capsule** is the first end-to-end capsule lab (Memo 23 §9
step 4). You will define the `oe.greeting` capsule against the
adopted upstream contract, validate it with the upstream schema,
implement it in a stdlib Python function behind that contract, test
it, compose it into a minimal Pico definition, and resolve the
Pico's capability requirement against your capsule **by hand**.

The lab is intentionally small — about 45–60 minutes — and reuses the
Hello Pico greeting (`"Hello, Pico!"`) at the **capability** level so
you can see the capsule-first restatement of the same observable
behaviour.

## What you will produce

A single capsule named `greeting-capsule` — matching the `produces`
entry in this lab's [`metadata.yaml`](metadata.yaml). Concretely:
`solution/capsule.yaml`, a stdlib implementation in
`solution/greeting.py`, passing unit and contract tests under
`solution/tests/`, a minimal composing `solution/pico.yaml`, and a
hand-written `solution/resolution.md` in the shape of the upstream
`resolve-greeting.yaml` scenario.

::: {.callout-important title="Python call convention is a course-local teaching harness"}
This lab calls the capsule as a Python function behind its declared
`spec.inputs`/`spec.outputs`. That calling convention is a
**course-local teaching harness only**. The implementation convention
for capsules belongs to `open-engineering-capsule/source`, which has
published none yet (`memo24` §2.1 as updated by observation at the
pinned upstream commit `bf071c2c1b57`). When the implementation org
publishes a convention, the Academy will consume it; this lab will
not fork or shadow it (`memo23` §3.2, `memo26` §5).
:::

## Upstream artefacts (fetched, never vendored)

The lab reads the normative capsule schema and fixtures directly from
`open-engineering-capsules/source` at the pinned commit
`bf071c2c1b57`. A small script, `solution/fetch-upstream.sh`,
downloads them into an untracked `build/upstream/` directory (the
lab-local `.gitignore` ignores `build/`; `build/` is one of the
pruned directory names in `scripts/oels_ci_validate.py` so the
fetched OE-shaped fixtures do not trip the OELS gate). The lab
commits **no schema copy** and **no resolver** — only the capsule,
its implementation, its tests, the Pico, the fetch script and the
hand resolution report.
